cues: Breeders make polyploids with colchicine, from the autumn crocus.
It stops the spindle forming, so the doubled chromosomes stay in one nucleus.
Polyploids show the gigas effect: bigger cells, leaves, flowers and fruits.
And odd polyploids, like triploids, are sterile, because three sets cannot pair evenly.
That is exactly why a banana has no seeds.
